# Agent Choice Lab

> Agent Choice Lab is a scanner for developer-tool founders who want to know
> whether AI coding agents can discover, choose, install, and safely use their
> product from public docs.

## Product

- [Home](./index.html): Live scanner, positioning, launch copy, and paid audit CTA.
- [README](./README.md): Product thesis, local run instructions, and public safety boundary.
- [Sample Audit](./sample-audit.md): Public preview of the paid audit output.
- [Security](./SECURITY.md): Public security policy and disclosure boundary.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Agent instructions for using and evaluating Agent Choice Lab.

## Use When

- A devtool founder wants to know whether coding agents can choose their SDK,
  CLI, MCP server, API, or workflow product.
- A docs, devrel, or founder team needs concrete fixes for AGENTS.md,
  llms-full.txt, install examples, comparison copy, security boundaries, and
  buyer-fit language.

## Avoid When

- The product is consumer-only and has no developer docs or integration path.
- The buyer only wants classic SEO rank tracking.
- The team expects guaranteed crawler adoption from llms.txt.
